gen-eater-gf-ubuntu: Dark and snarling, Eater's wide-set letters and stubby ascenders meet Ubuntu, a modern sans with a lofty lowercase band. The tension between menace and modernity is the whole appeal.
gen-eater-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono is a precise monospace with bowls left open on one side. Across paragraphs, the loose spacing gives text a measured, structured gait, a steady counterweight to Eater's dark, aggressive headlines.
gen-eater-gf-viga: Wide gaps and stubby ascenders give Eater its dark, aggressive stance. Made small, it loses menace, while Viga, a plain sans of hairline-free strokes, holds up at any size.
gen-eater-gf-voces: Eater's thin strokes never shrink to hairlines, and its wide gaps and stubby ascenders give the headline a dark, aggressive edge. Voces, a tall-built sans, reads smoothly, its stems and hairlines close in weight.
gen-eater-gf-winky-rough: Eater brings dark, aggressive display letters with wide gaps between them. Winky Rough, a plain sans whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, gives that menace a contemporary, level-headed counterpart on the page.
gen-eater-gf-winky-sans: Winky Sans is a modern sans whose capitals barely rise above its lowercase. And Eater, dark and aggressive, earns its keep when set big and short, where its wide gaps show.
gen-eater-gf-yantramanav: Rounded glyphs with spacious terminal gaps, set tightly together, give this body a clean, modern read beneath Eater's dark heading. Yantramanav, a sans-serif whose lowercase nearly reaches the capitals, keeps a paragraph moving without snagging.
gen-eater-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is a modern sans-serif drawn as one monoline. Its curve endings stay well apart, so paragraphs read precisely and smoothly, a quiet foil for Eater's dark, aggressive headlines.
gen-eater-sora: Sora is a precise, geometric sans-serif whose curves turn corners without any pressure swell and whose letters stay widely parted. Eater supplies the dark, aggressive bite; Sora keeps the rest crisp.
gen-eater-space-grotesk: Eater is dark and aggressive, with wide gaps and short ascenders that give each word real bite. But Space Grotesk, a geometric sans-serif with generous counters and constant-width strokes, does the quiet work of carrying text.
